description: This file defines classes and functions related to sharding DataPipes in PyTorch, including sharding priorities, a sharding filter DataPipe, and sharding application logic.

classes.name: SHARDING_PRIORITIES
classes.description: Enumeration for sharding priority levels: DEFAULT, DISTRIBUTED, MULTIPROCESSING.

classes.name: _ShardingIterDataPipe
classes.description: Base class for sharding DataPipe, defines apply_sharding method to be implemented.

classes.name: ShardingFilterIterDataPipe
classes.description: A DataPipe wrapper that filters data based on sharding configuration, allowing data to be split across multiple workers.

methods.name: apply_sharding
methods.description: Configures sharding parameters for the DataPipe, specifying number of instances, instance ID, and sharding group.

methods.name: _update_num_of_instances
methods.description: Updates the total number of instances and the current instance ID based on sharding groups.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ShardingFilterIterDataPipe with a source DataPipe and optional sharding group filter.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Iterates over the source DataPipe, yielding only elements assigned to this instance based on sharding.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the DataPipe for this sharding instance if the source is sized.
